text:
Ashwin: starting schema migration job for customer_profiles -> add `last_seen` (timestamp) + TTL index on last_seen. Planned window: 30m maintenance lull. Kicking @deploybot now. please ack and watch for holdpoints.

deploybot: mig job queued: mig-20260323-78. running on r8db-7. will auto-pause if lock_wait > 12s or replica_lag > 50s for >90s. publishing stream to this thread. :robot_face: logs -> https://deployments.internal/logs/mig-20260323-78

Maria: quick check 12: are any analytics ETL batches scheduled during this window?

Jordan: ETL window had a tiny job at :15 but we moved it earlier. i'm also throttling an internal report generator to 0.1 qps for customer_profiles. Ran: `/throttle job report-gen --table=customer_profiles --rate=0.1`

Sam: drafting release note: "Schema: last_seen column + TTL index. Migration performed in maintenance window. Backwards-compatible for reads. Clients should tolerate null for existing rows." pinning release ref v2.1.0-rc4.

SRE-Oncall: need clear pause vs rollback rules and an escape hatch. Also request healthcheck dashboard monitor (p50/p95 write latency, replica lag).

Ashwin: agreed. Pause (soft hold) triggers: any single lock_wait > 12s OR replica_lag > 50s sustained >90s OR node CPU >85% for 2m. In that case deploybot will pause and post holdpin. Full rollback triggers: migration job exits with non-zero status 2x OR sustained write errors >40% for 5m OR customer-facing error rate >3% above baseline for 3m. Escape hatch: manual pin `release:unpin-mig-20260323-78` to abort. Rollback steps quick:
```
-- stop migrator
systemctl stop migrator.service || true
-- kill active ALTERs
SELECT pid FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE customer_profiles' AND state <> 'idle'; -- then pg_terminate_backend(pid)
-- revert schema
ALTER TABLE customer_profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_seen;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_customer_profiles_last_seen_ttl;
```
Full runbook in /runbooks/migrations/customer_profiles.md.

deploybot: holdpoint hook added. current stats: processed_rows=18,400; throughput ~150 rows/s; no lock.wait >12s observed. Posting perf snapshot to infra metrics.

Maria: looked at planner for a sample chunk; EXPLAIN looks fine (index scan on pk). No seq scans yet. If you want, i'll run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on chunk id 7.

Jordan: replica drain completed, lag steady ~8s. continuing to tail.

product-bot: @product notifying: migration in maintenance window; release v2.1.0-rc4 pinned. Will notify customers with opt-in telemetry next week.

Sam: also adding a line to release notes about rollout gating: will enable TTL enforcement in 2 weeks after traffic validation.

SRE-Oncall: setting temporary alert: alert if write_latency_p50 > 200ms or replica_lag > 60s.

Ashwin: thanks team. next checkpoint at 50k rows processed or if deploybot posts a hold. standby."
